headline.zh: 独特手冲与发酵风味滤泡咖啡
headline.en: Unique pour-overs and fermented filter brews

traits.zh: 所有咖啡豆在深圳烘焙后空运到上海
traits.en: Beans roasted in Shenzhen, air-freighted to Shanghai

traits.zh: 主打手冲咖啡，提供冷萃和咖啡教育
traits.en: Specializes in hand-drip, cold brew, and coffee education

traits.zh: 招牌饮品为‘不倒翁咖啡’
右侧橙子实为一款甜点，可配咖啡组成简式下午茶
traits.en: Orange-shaped dessert pairs well with coffee for a light afternoon tea

traits.zh: 店内放置老式收银机等古老装置，像实验室
traits.en: Decorated with vintage items, feels like a lab

adventure.zh: 主打手冲和实验性咖啡
adventure.en: Focus on pour-overs and experimental brews
